Wednesday 10:00–10:30 is the only slot I can make next week. Would that work for the two of you?

Hi Ajay — Wednesday 10:00–10:30 works for me. My Wednesday lecture ends at 10:00 and research starts at 10:30, so that half hour is free; I've put the meeting in my calendar for next Wednesday (25 Nov).

Two alternatives that are free on my side next Wednesday: 12:30–13:00 or 15:00–15:30. If neither fits you, give me another day and time within 09:00–17:00 and I'll check it. Chris, happy to have you there if it works for you.
Thanks, Chris — noted for Wednesday 25 Nov, 10:00–10:30. I'll book it in my calendar once the professor confirms.

Chris — no, it doesn't suit me: I have Faculty senate 10:00–11:00 next Wednesday, so 10:00–10:30 is out for me. Free on my side that day: 12:30–13:00 or 15:00–15:30. I'd rather not move the senate meeting. If Wednesday is the only day that works for you both, pick one of those two; otherwise propose another day and time between 09:00 and 17:00. I've asked the department office to confirm next week's official schedule.

Hello — could you confirm the official schedule for next week (week of Monday 23 November)? In particular, is the Faculty senate still on Wednesday 25 November, 10:00–11:00? For context, the rest of that Wednesday: CSE444, CSE455 and CSE544 lectures 09:00–10:00, Department meeting 14:00–15:00, TA office hours 14:00–17:00, Office hours 15:30–17:00.

I can't see private appointments or arrange meetings myself, so you'd need to confirm with Professor Alvarez and Chris directly.

Noted. I'm checking with the department office whether anything official next week clashes with 12:30–13:00 or 15:00–15:30 on Wednesday; I'll confirm the slot as soon as they answer. If neither works for you, say so now and propose another time.

Thanks, Professor — glad to be included.

Bad luck on timing, though: my Wednesday is full apart from the 10:00–10:30 half hour. 12:30–13:00 sits inside my research block (10:30–14:00) and 15:00–15:30 inside my TA office hours (14:00–17:00), so neither of yours works for me, and yours (Faculty senate) rules out Ajay's.

Ajay, if Wednesday is the only day you can make, option 1 is probably the cleaner one — say which you prefer.
